peer_candidates.title: Missing gjs silently removes the ownership contract from ctest
peer_candidates.reason: The invoking scope explicitly requires an optional native-GJS-only contract and intentional skip on the non-GNOME host. Registration was optional before this change as well; the configure STATUS message accurately reports the selected native-lab coverage.

peer_candidates.title: Async gjs module failure may exit 0 and pass CTest
peer_candidates.reason: Existing supported GNOME guest GJS 1.88 exits 1 for a throw after top-level await; a permanently pending await does not exit and reached the 5-second supervisor timeout. The test has a 30-second CTest timeout. No false-green interpreter outcome was reproduced.

residual_scope_limits: Real GJS globals remain accessible during direct eval, but the deliberately mocked Shell/Gio/GLib/Main/global dependencies used by current ownership code are lexically shadowed. No current real dependency was found in tested paths.
An old unrelated GJS version may fail loudly; the supported GNOME50 environment already records GJS1.88 success.
